diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: A friend game-invite popup (from "Co2Tyson67") appeared over the LST HUNT screen while `tap_all_claims` was scanning; because `tap_all_claims` is not in `_dismiss_before`, the popup-dismiss hook never ran to close it — the popup covered the 3rd card's timer, causing OCR to find only 2/3 timers and triggering low-confidence sleep-cap scheduling (no reward was missed this cycle since all cards were locked, but a ready card under the popup would be unclaimed).
